payload.title: Channel tokens are checked daily, and only a definite answer changes a channel
payload.context: M6 review (#6): the token check the documents relied on had no caller, so scopes went stale and a revoked token was noticed only by a failed publish.
payload.rationale: A scheduled command checks each active channel once a day on the insights queue, updates scopes and expiry, and marks a channel as needing reconnection only when the platform says the token is invalid, expired, or lacks a required scope. An outage, a rate limit or an ambiguous answer leaves the channel untouched, because a wrong mark stops publishing.
payload.consequences: It never reactivates a channel. A good check ends a reading pause. Token checks share the insights worker and never compete with publishing.
